About
We wanted a puzzle that didn't shout at us
Word Hug started as a note in a phone: three words, one that fits all three. Nothing more.
Every daily puzzle app we tried came with a stopwatch, a percentile, and a push notification telling us our streak was in danger. We liked the puzzle part. We didn't like being managed by it.
So the rules of the app are the rules we wanted for ourselves. One puzzle a day, about a minute. No clock. Six tries, and if you use a nudge, nothing about your solve changes — no asterisk, no smaller confetti. The last seven days stay open so a missed morning isn't a loss. There is one number in the whole game, and it's there because people asked for it, not because it makes you come back.
We pay for it with Hug Packs — thirty themed puzzles, bought once, yours forever. The daily puzzle stays free because it's the whole point. There are no ads, no accounts, and nothing about your play leaves your phone.
